blocks.raw:
<WikiTableTabs
  caption="PD 1096 Rule VII controls to separate before computing"
  tables='[{"id": "pd1096-location-controls", "title": "Location checks", "content": "| Control | Source path | What the architect asks | Common trap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct access | Section 704.1(a) | Does the building adjoin or directly access a public space, yard, or street on at least one side? | Jumping to area arithmetic before checking access |
| Adjacent property line | Section 704.1(b) | Is an adjoining street or alley centerline treated as an adjacent property line for this rule? | Reading property-line language too literally |
| Eaves over required windows | Section 704.1(c) | Are eaves over required windows at least 750 mm from side and rear property lines? | Detaching the 750 mm value from its condition |"}, {"id": "pd1096-area-controls", "title": "Area controls", "content": "| Control | Source path | What it regulates | Common trap |
|---|---|---|---|
| AMBF | Section 704.4 | Allowable maximum building footprint | Using TGFA when the prompt asks for footprint |
| TGFA | Section 705.1-705.2 | Allowable maximum total gross floor area | Using footprint logic for total floor area |
| Table VII.1 percentages | Section 705.2 | Initial allowable maximum TGFA as percentages of Total Lot Area | Treating storey multiplier numbers as percentages |"}]'
/>
